extracted.intended_audience: AO3 fanfiction readers and iPhone users looking for a dedicated fanfiction reading app
extracted.subtask_description: Finding, filtering, and reading fanfiction from Archive of Our Own on an iPhone, using fandom/ship/trope filters and app features (offline, themes, search).

rubrics_metrics.name: Popular Fandoms
rubrics_metrics.description: Lists major fandoms to browse (e.g., Harry Potter, MCU, Supernatural, BTS, Sherlock BBC, Good Omens) with counts of works available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use fandom filters to find works within a specific fictional universe; page shows brief fandom descriptions (e.g., 'The wizarding world created by J.K. Rowling...').

rubrics_metrics.name: Popular Ships
rubrics_metrics.description: Common character pairings used as a way to find stories (examples: Drarry — Draco Malfoy/Harry Potter; Destiel — Castiel/Dean Winchester; Stucky — Bucky Barnes/Steve Rogers; Johnlock — Sherlock Holmes/John Watson; BakuDeku — Bakugou Katsuki/Midoriya Izuku; Taekook — Kim Taehyung/Jeon Jungkook).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Filter or search by ship name to locate stories focusing on those relationships; counts indicate popularity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Slow Burn (trope)
rubrics_metrics.description: A romance that develops gradually over time, with tension building across chapters or the entire story.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this trope tag to identify stories focused on slow-developing romantic tension rather than instant relationships.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enemies to Lovers (trope)
rubrics_metrics.description: Characters who start as adversaries and gradually develop romantic feelings for each other.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tag indicates a narrative arc from conflict/antagonism to romantic resolution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Friends to Lovers (trope)
rubrics_metrics.description: Best friends who realize their feelings run deeper than friendship.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use to find stories where an existing platonic relationship converts into romance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hurt/Comfort (trope)
rubrics_metrics.description: One character is hurt (physically or emotionally) and another provides comfort and care.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Signals stories emphasizing recovery, caretaking, and emotional support dynamics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fix-It (trope)
rubrics_metrics.description: Stories that 'fix' canon events that fans found unsatisfying, usually character deaths or relationship outcomes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tag for alternate resolutions that correct or change undesired canonical developments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alternate Universe (AU) (trope)
rubrics_metrics.description: Stories set in a different universe or setting than canon, from coffee shops to space operas.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates the work departs from canonical worldbuilding, placing familiar characters into new contexts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Completed Fics (filter)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this filter to restrict search results to works with a completed status (useful for readers who prefer full narratives).

rubrics_metrics.name: Long Fics (filter)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Filter for very long-form works (epics) when readers want extended, in-depth storytelling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Famous Fics (curation)
rubrics_metrics.description: Curated list/category intended to surface well-known or widely recommended works.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A discovery tool for readers seeking notable or influential fanworks; not a formal quality metric but a popularity/recognition signal.

rubrics_metrics.name: In-depth Fic Guides (resource)
rubrics_metrics.description: Guides that provide deeper context, commentary, or analyses about particular fanfics or themes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these guides for recommendations and to understand why certain works are notable or how to approach them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Glossary (resource)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resource to learn tagging/trope/ship terminology used on AO3 and in fan communities; helps with effective searching and categorization.

rubrics_metrics.name: AO3 Tips & Tricks (guides)
rubrics_metrics.description: Practical guidance for using AO3 effectively (searching, filtering, navigating).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Helps readers and writers understand site-specific tools and conventions to find or present work better.

rubrics_metrics.name: Beautiful Reading (app feature / presentation criterion)
rubrics_metrics.description: Custom fonts, themes, and formatting options for the perfect reading experience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presentation features aimed at improving readability and aesthetics; relevant when choosing an app for reading fanfiction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Offline Reading (app feature / accessibility criterion)
rubrics_metrics.description: Download your favorite fics and read them anywhere, no internet required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A usability/accessibility criterion for readers who need offline access to works.

rubrics_metrics.name: Powerful Search (app feature / discovery criterion)
rubrics_metrics.description: Find exactly what you're looking for with advanced filters and sorting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quality of discovery depends on filter granularity (fandom, ship, trope, length, completion); this is an evaluative dimension for how effectively an app surfaces desired works.
